parameters.description: low mound of grey stone with thick seams of rusty orange iron ore running through it, black outline, warm earthy tones, NES-era retro pixel art, few colors

hit.animationDescription: the stone mound shudders slightly from a pick blow and settles still, the rocks staying in place, no particles, no effects

down.animationDescription: the stone mound slowly settles and sinks down into a low flat scatter of broken grey rubble on the ground, the stones keeping their grey colour, no flash, no particles, no effects

endFrame.editDescription: the mound has been mined away: only a low flat scatter of broken grey stone rubble remains on the ground, with no orange ore left; empty transparent space above it
